column1: REGIONAL INTERVENTION: Prioritize monitoring network density in Gurugram (MAE: 20.9), identified as the region with the highest model deviations.
SEASONAL CONTINGENCY: Implement preventative emissions capping during the Summer season (MAE: 15.7) due to recurring meteorological patterns conducive to high errors.
MODEL ADJUSTMENT: Account for a 74.4% rate of underpredicting extreme conditions by adding a safety margin buffer on severe forecasting alerts.
